node.drug:
MATCH (d:Drug {name: $label})-[:TARGETS]->(t:Target)
RETURN d, collect(t.symbol) AS targets
node.target:
MATCH (d:Drug)-[:TARGETS]->(t:Target {symbol: $label})
RETURN t, collect(d.name) AS drugs
node.condition:
MATCH (d:Drug)<-[:TESTS]-(tr:Trial)-[:STUDIES]->(c:Condition {name: $label})
RETURN d.name, count(tr) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC
edge.TESTED_IN:
MATCH (d:Drug)<-[:TESTS]-(tr:Trial)-[:STUDIES]->(c:Condition)
WITH d, c, count(tr) AS n
MERGE (d)-[r:TESTED_IN]->(c)
SET r.trials = n
bridge:
MATCH (d:Drug {name: $label})-[:TESTED_IN]->(c:Condition)
WITH d, collect(DISTINCT c.area) AS areas
WHERE size(areas) >= 2
RETURN d.name, areas
